title: Steward Status
description: A steward's status at a station in the active scenario (MET-A-015). A steward without a status has not assigned themselves in this activation, and every new activation starts with none. Allowed changes: none to ASSIGNED (assign); ASSIGNED to ASSIGNED at another station (change station before arriving); ASSIGNED to CHECKED_IN at the same station (check in); ASSIGNED to CHECKED_OUT at the same station (cancel without arriving); CHECKED_IN to CHECKED_OUT at the same station (check out); CHECKED_OUT to ASSIGNED (take a new station). Sending the status and station the steward already has is a harmless repeat. Any other change is rejected with E1006.

userId.description: The steward, as userId in GET /api/v1/me.

activationId.description: The activation the status belongs to.

station.description: A station that requires manning in the active scenario.

changedAt.description: Server time of the last change. A harmless repeat does not move it.

StewardStatusValue.description: ASSIGNED: the steward has chosen the station and is on the way (assign). CHECKED_IN: the steward is at the station (check in). CHECKED_OUT: the steward has left the station (check out).
